# Trend Strength Index

*Correlation of price with time, -1 to 1.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Trend Strength Index** under **Trend**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `14` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/trendstrength.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Trend Strength Index", shortTitle: "Trend Strength", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const length = input.int("Length", 14, { min: 2 });
const index = ta.cum(ta.calc([candle.close], () => 1));
plot(ta.correlation(candle.close, index, length), { title: "Trend Strength", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(0, { title: "Zero", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dashed" });
```
